newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks down sharply on rupiah woes.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks down sharply on rupiah woes.

text.p: The Jakarta stock index fell sharply in early trading on Monday following the plunge of the rupiah against the dollar, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index was down 9.10 points, or 1.26 percent, at 714.90 points at around 0315 GMT. Decliners led advancers by 59 to 10 with 41 issues unchanged.
Newly-listed chemical firm Lautan Luas was the most active, with volume approaching 14 million shares.
Lautan was last traded at 3,575 rupiah against an offer price of 2,950 rupiah.
"It is still a good debut considering the overall weak market sentiment," another broker said.
Brokers said overall market sentiment was seen staying cautious the rest of the day as the rupiah was likely to remain volatile. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
